_note: M7 (R9.54): the wind over the meadow (crates/core/src/wind.rs), after the fishing game's waves: four travelling waves summed, each toward a heading (degrees, 0 north, 90 west), so long (m), so fast (cm a second) and so strong (percent of the whole). It bends the blades' tips bend_cm at a full gust and rolls sheen and shadow over the grass on the ground; between the grass's clumps darker troughs, trough_pct dark, two waves crossing trough_cm long. A ground colour is grass where it is greener than its red and blue by the first grass_key (0 to 255), wholly so by the second.
